p: sixth year: Of the captivity of Jeconiah.
sixth month: Which contained part of August and part of September.
visions of God to Jerusalem: Meaning that he was thus carried in spirit, and not in body.
gate that looketh toward the north: Which was the porch or the court where the people assembled.
jealousy: So called, because it provoked God's indignation, which was the idol of Baal.
altar this image of jealousy in: That is, in the court where the people had made an altar to Baal.
my sanctuary: For God will not be where the idols are.
abominable beasts: Which were forbidden in the law, Le 11:4.
men of the elders of the: Thus they who would have kept all the rest in the fear and true service of God were the ringleaders of all abomination, and by their example pulled others from God.
a thick cloud of incense went: It was in such abundance.
do in the dark: For besides their common idolatry they had particular service, which they had in secret chambers.
Tammuz: The Jews write, that this was a prophet of the idols, who after his death was once a year mourned for in the night.
branch to their nose: Declaring that the censings and service of the idolaters are but infections and villany before God.
